WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.

4. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

5. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.

6. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.

7. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

10. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.

11. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

12. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
